Success](https://web.njit.edu/~rt494/security/)
- {{< iconify fa6-solid book-open size=18px >}} Review chapters four through twelve
[Cracking Codes with Python](https://inventwithpython.com/cracking/)

## Activities

- {{< iconify fa6-solid people-line size=18px >}} **Monday and Wednesday**: Malware
- {{< iconify fa6-solid people-line size=18px >}} **Friday**: Complete a computer security check
  - Complete a form-based assessment on your laptop
  - Complete an in-person assessment with course instructor
- {{< iconify fa6-solid diagram-project size=18px >}} **Friday**: Laboratory session
  - Complete and submit the [Security Survey Project One: Server Fuzzing](/../projects/)
    - Using your own laptop, give a public demonstration and presentation of
  the project to the instructor and your peers
  - Start working on [Security Survey Project Two: Cryptography Benchmarking](/../projects/)
